name: YTarr
author: Tw1zT3d2four7
description: Import up to five YouTube Music playlists into Dispatcharr with artwork, native dummy EPG listings, and continuous radio channels.

fields.label: YouTube Music playlist 1 URL
fields.help_text: Public YouTube / YouTube Music playlist URL.

fields.label: Stream profile name
fields.help_text: Must match an existing Dispatcharr stream profile.

fields.label: Maximum tracks per playlist
fields.help_text: Safety cap per playlist; allowed range 1-500.

fields.label: Create continuous radio channel(s)
fields.help_text: Create one radio channel per playlist that automatically advances through tracks. Requires streamlink and ffmpeg in the Dispatcharr container.

actions.label: Check YTarr Status
actions.description: Check Dispatcharr model access and stream profile.

actions.label: Import YouTube Music Playlists (up to 5)
actions.description: Import all configured playlist URLs and create/update one selectable channel per unique track.

confirm.title: Import playlists?
confirm.message: This will create or update channels for tracks found in up to five configured public playlists.

actions.label: Generate/Refresh Dummy EPG
actions.description: Generate placeholder programme listings for existing YTarr channels so names appear in the guide.
